tools.name: contactSales
tools.description: Navigate to the TESS pricing page for sales and plan questions. Does not send any message on the user's behalf.

tools.name: explainCredits
tools.description: Explain how credits work in TESS — units of consumption, monthly allowance, top-ups. Returns a canonical text answer. Read-only.

tools.name: getGlossary
tools.description: Returns the canonical TESS glossary URL (HTML and markdown) so AI agents can resolve product terminology.

tools.name: getPricingPlans
tools.description: Returns the TESS AI pricing plans currently visible on this page (name, price, currency, frequency, description). Read-only.

tools.name: openPricing
tools.description: Navigate the current tab to the TESS pricing page. Does not perform any purchase.

tools.name: openSignup
tools.description: Navigate the current tab to the TESS sign-up page so the user can create a free account. Does not submit any form.

tools.name: searchAiModels
tools.description: Search the AI models currently exposed on this page by label. Returns matching model labels, categories and an availability flag. Read-only.

query.description: Substring to search for in the model label (case-insensitive).
